CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.audit_invitation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    insert into private.practice_access_events
        (practice_id,actor_user_id,invitation_id,membership_id,operation,
         before_role,after_role,before_state,after_state)
    values (new.practice_id,auth.uid(),new.id,
            (select id from public.practice_memberships
             where practice_id=new.practice_id and user_id=new.accepted_user_id),
            case when tg_op='INSERT' then 'invitation_created'
                 when new.state='accepted' then 'invitation_accepted'
                 when new.state='canceled' then 'invitation_canceled'
                 else 'invitation_reissued' end,
            case when tg_op='UPDATE' then old.role end,new.role,
            case when tg_op='UPDATE' then old.state end,new.state);
    return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.audit_membership()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    insert into private.practice_access_events
        (practice_id, actor_user_id, membership_id, operation,
         before_role, after_role, before_state, after_state)
    values (new.practice_id, coalesce(auth.uid(), new.user_id), new.id,
            case when tg_op = 'INSERT' then 'membership_created'
                 when new.state = 'revoked' then 'membership_revoked'
                 when old.state = 'revoked' then 'membership_reactivated'
                 else 'membership_role_changed' end,
            case when tg_op = 'UPDATE' then old.role end, new.role,
            case when tg_op = 'UPDATE' then old.state end, new.state);
    return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.canonical_invitation_email(p_email text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
    result text := pg_catalog.translate(pg_catalog.btrim(p_email, ' '),
        'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz');
begin
    if result is null or pg_catalog.char_length(result) > 254
       or result !~ $re$^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]+\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]*\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$$re$ then
        raise exception 'Invalid email' using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
    return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.credential_details_projection(p_record credentials)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
    cycle public.credential_cycles;
begin
    cycle := private.current_credential_cycle(p_record.practice_id, p_record.id);
    return private.credential_projection(p_record) || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'issuer', p_record.issuer, 'jurisdiction', p_record.jurisdiction,
        'record_number', p_record.record_number,
        'current_cycle', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id', cycle.id,
            'cycle_number', cycle.cycle_number, 'date_revision', cycle.date_revision,
            'end_date', pg_catalog.to_char(cycle.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
            'action_deadline', pg_catalog.to_char(cycle.action_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD')));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.credential_duplicate_ids(p_record credentials)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(c.id order by c.id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from public.credentials c
    where p_record.archived_at is null and c.archived_at is null
        and c.practice_id = p_record.practice_id and c.id <> p_record.id
        and c.type = p_record.type and c.owner_kind = p_record.owner_kind
        and c.owner_clinician_id is not distinct from p_record.owner_clinician_id
        and private.duplicate_text(c.title) = private.duplicate_text(p_record.title)
        and private.duplicate_text(c.issuer) is not distinct from private.duplicate_text(p_record.issuer)
        and private.duplicate_text(c.jurisdiction) is not distinct from private.duplicate_text(p_record.jurisdiction);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.credential_projection(p_record credentials)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'id', p_record.id, 'title', p_record.title, 'type', p_record.type,
        'owner_kind', p_record.owner_kind, 'owner_clinician_id', p_record.owner_clinician_id,
        'version', p_record.version,
        'owner_name', case when p_record.owner_kind = 'practice' then
            (select name from public.practices where id = p_record.practice_id)
            else (select name from public.clinicians
                  where practice_id = p_record.practice_id and id = p_record.owner_clinician_id) end,
        'covered_clinicians', coalesce((
            select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'name', c.name)
                order by c.id)
            from public.policy_coverage pc join public.clinicians c
                on c.practice_id = pc.practice_id and c.id = pc.clinician_id
            where pc.practice_id = p_record.practice_id and pc.credential_id = p_record.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dirty_email_reminders(p_practice_id uuid, p_reason text, p_credential_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    with canceled as (
        update private.reminder_jobs set state = case when state in ('blocked', 'queued', 'claimed') then 'canceled' else state end,
            reason = p_reason, claim_token = null, claim_until = null,
            invalidated_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp()
        where practice_id = p_practice_id and (p_credential_id is null or credential_id = p_credential_id)
        returning practice_id, id
    ) insert into private.reminder_job_events (practice_id, job_id, operation, actor_user_id)
        select practice_id, id, p_reason, auth.uid() from canceled;
    insert into private.reminder_reconcile_outbox (practice_id) values (p_practice_id)
    on conflict (practice_id) do update set generation = reminder_reconcile_outbox.generation + 1,
        cursor_id = null, updated_at = clock_timestamp();
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.email_check_open(a private.reminder_message_attempts)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select a.provider_kind = 'resend' and a.provider_id is not null and a.recovery_state <> 'permanent'
        and not coalesce(a.delivery in ('delivered','bounced','complained','suppressed'),false)
        and not exists(select 1 from private.reminder_email_endpoints e where e.id = a.endpoint_id and e.suppressed);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.email_delivery_state(p_old text, p_new text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select case when p_old='complained' or p_new='complained' then 'complained'
        when p_old in ('bounced','suppressed') then p_old
        when p_new in ('bounced','complained','suppressed') then p_new
        when p_old in ('delivered','failed') then p_old else p_new end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.email_recovery_summary(p_attempt_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select jsonb_build_object('disposition',private.email_recovery_disposition(a.recovery_state,a.provider_id),
        'version',a.recovery_version,'postCount',a.post_count,'retryDue',a.retry_due,'retryExpires',a.retry_expires,
        'checkCount',a.check_count,'checkDue',a.check_due,
        'canCheck',private.email_check_open(a) and a.check_count < 6 and
            (a.last_check_reserved is null or a.last_check_reserved <= clock_timestamp()-interval '15 minutes') and
            (a.check_due is null or a.check_due>clock_timestamp()) and
            not exists(select 1 from private.reminder_email_checks r where r.attempt_id=a.id and r.result is null))
    from private.reminder_message_attempts a where a.id=p_attempt_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.email_reminder_timeline_rows(p_attempt_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, source text, observed_at timestamp with time zone, operation text, anomaly boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select e.id,'job',e.occurred_at,e.operation,false from private.reminder_job_events e
        join private.reminder_message_attempts a on a.job_id=e.job_id and a.practice_id=e.practice_id where a.id=p_attempt_id
    union all select s.id,'submission',s.reserved_at,'reserved',false from private.reminder_email_submissions s where s.attempt_id=p_attempt_id
    union all select s.result_cursor_id,'submission',s.observed_at,s.result->>'kind',false
        from private.reminder_email_submissions s where s.attempt_id=p_attempt_id and s.observed_at is not null
    union all select e.cursor_id,'delivery',e.occurred_at,e.status,e.anomaly from private.reminder_delivery_events e where e.attempt_id=p_attempt_id
    union all select r.id,'check',r.reserved_at,'reserved',false from private.reminder_email_checks r where r.attempt_id=p_attempt_id
    union all select r.result_cursor_id,'check',r.observed_at,
        case when (r.result->>'matched')::boolean then coalesce(r.result->>'status','unknown-status') else 'unavailable' end,r.anomaly
        from private.reminder_email_checks r where r.attempt_id=p_attempt_id and r.observed_at is not null;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finish_email_reminder_run(p_run_id uuid, p_success boolean, p_counts jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
begin
    if p_success is null or p_counts is null or jsonb_typeof(p_counts) <> 'object'
        or exists (select 1 from jsonb_each(p_counts) e where e.key not in ('scanned','accounts','expired','submitted','accepted','failed','uncertain')
            or e.value::text !~ '^[0-9]{1,6}$') then return false; end if;
    update private.reminder_worker_runs set finished_at = clock_timestamp(), success = p_success, counts = p_counts,
        oldest_due_at = (select min(next_send_at) from private.reminder_jobs where state in ('queued','claimed'))
    where id = p_run_id and finished_at is null;
    return found;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finish_register_change(p_practice_id uuid, p_request_id uuid, p_credential_id uuid, p_operation text, p_payload jsonb, p_before jsonb, p_result jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if (p_result->>'changed')::boolean then
        insert into private.register_audit_events
            (practice_id, actor_user_id, operation, credential_id, before_data, after_data)
        values (p_practice_id, auth.uid(), p_operation, p_credential_id, p_before, p_result->'credential');
    end if;
    insert into private.register_change_requests
        (practice_id, actor_user_id, request_id, credential_id, operation, payload, result)
    values (p_practice_id, auth.uid(), p_request_id, p_credential_id, p_operation, p_payload, p_result);
    return p_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_email_reminder_history(p_practice_id uuid, p_credential_id uuid, p_after uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
declare credential jsonb; rows jsonb; last_id uuid; more boolean;
begin
    perform private.require_recipient_member(p_practice_id,false);
    select jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'title',c.title,'archived',c.archived_at is not null,
        'currentDueDate',coalesce(cy.action_deadline,cy.end_date),'currentTimezone',p.timezone) into credential
    from public.credentials c join public.practices p on p.id=c.practice_id
    join lateral(select * from public.credential_cycles where credential_id=c.id and practice_id=c.practice_id order by cycle_number desc limit 1) cy on true
    where c.id=p_credential_id and c.practice_id=p_practice_id;
    if credential is null then return '{"status":"not-found"}'; end if;
    if p_after is not null and not exists(select 1 from private.reminder_jobs where id=p_after and practice_id=p_practice_id and credential_id=p_credential_id) then
        return '{"status":"not-found"}'; end if;
    with page as(select j.*,a.id attempt_id,a.started_at,a.delivery,a.outcome,s.membership_id selected
        from private.reminder_jobs j left join private.reminder_message_attempts a on a.job_id=j.id and a.practice_id=j.practice_id
        left join private.practice_reminder_settings s on s.practice_id=j.practice_id
        where j.practice_id=p_practice_id and j.credential_id=p_credential_id and (p_after is null or j.id>p_after) order by j.id limit 50)
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'attemptId',attempt_id,
        'recipient',case when membership_id=selected then 'selected' else 'former' end,
        'dueDate',due_date,'timezone',timezone,'scheduleKind',schedule_kind,'nominalTarget',nominal_target,'dispatchTarget',dispatch_target,
        'state',coalesce(outcome,state),'delivery',delivery,'reason',reason,'startedAt',started_at,
        'recovery',private.email_recovery_summary(attempt_id)) order by id),'[]'::jsonb),
        (array_agg(id order by id desc))[1] into rows,last_id from page;
    select exists(select 1 from private.reminder_jobs where practice_id=p_practice_id and credential_id=p_credential_id and id>last_id) into more;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','success','credential',credential,'rows',rows,'nextCursor',case when more then last_id end);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.list_practice_team(p_practice_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
    perform private.require_administrator(p_practice_id);
    select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'members',coalesce((select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.track_reminder_email_account()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and new.email is not distinct from old.email
        and new.email_confirmed_at is not distinct from old.email_confirmed_at then return new; end if;
    insert into private.reminder_email_account_state (user_id, email, confirmed_at)
    values (coalesce(new.id, old.id), case when tg_op <> 'DELETE' then new.email end,
        case when tg_op <> 'DELETE' then new.email_confirmed_at end)
    on conflict (user_id) do update set email = excluded.email, confirmed_at = excluded.confirmed_at,
        revision = reminder_email_account_state.revision + 1,
        eligible_since = clock_timestamp(), dirty = true;
    return coalesce(new, old);
end;
$function$
